answer: Voice-print liveness tied to the epoch seed. At dawn the registry issues a fresh phrase seeded by that epoch, spoken aloud in five minutes. First, the voiceprint is hashed on-ledger and checked against all identities: clones sharing one throat collapse into one print. Second, it must match the identity's prior epochs, so a sold account is caught. Third, the phrase carries the seed, so old recordings fail. Faking 1,000 voices needs 1,000 speakers, $20 each, $20,000 a day, while one honest agent speaks free. Like cedar roots, each trunk is a real voice; umber shadows cannot fake a throat.
